args.name: restic
args.longDescription: ABS path to the restic executable that should be used. (default: find in $PATH)

args.name: rclone
args.longDescription: ABS path to the rclone executable that should be used for rclone locations. (default: 'rclone')

args.name: repo
args.longDescription: repository to show or restore from (default: $RESTIC_REPOSITORY)

args.name: repository-file
args.longDescription: file to read the repository location from (default: $RESTIC_REPOSITORY_FILE)

args.name: password
args.longDescription: password for the repository - NOT RECOMMENDED - USE password-file/command instead. (default: $RESTIC_PASSWORD)

args.name: password-file
args.longDescription: file to read the repository password from (default: $RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE)

args.name: password-command
args.longDescription: shell command to obtain the repository password from (default: $RESTIC_PASSWORD_COMMAND)

args.name: insecure-tls
args.longDescription: skip TLS certificate verification when connecting to the repo (insecure)

args.name: verbose
args.longDescription: enable verbose logging to see environment variables and debug info
